title: EventBus callback self-unregister during delivery contract

contract.self_unregister: A callback can unregister itself during active event delivery
contract.current_delivery_continuity: Self-unregister does not interrupt the current event delivery chain
contract.delivery_preservation: Callbacks following the self-unregistering callback continue receiving the active event
contract.registry_update: The self-unregistered callback is removed from the listener registry
contract.future_delivery_absence: A self-unregistered callback does not receive subsequent events
contract.remaining_callback_preservation: Other callbacks remain registered and continue receiving events
contract.emit_success: EventBus.emit() remains successful after callback self-unregister
contract.registry_stability: Self-unregister during delivery does not corrupt the listener registry
contract.permission_enforcement: EventBus operations require the events permission
